what: Resume validation reads BRANCH_NAME from ship-pr-state.sh but open-pr/merged hydration only sets pr_number/pr_url (and merge fields); _write_ship_state still emits BRANCH_NAME from ctx.branch_name or ctx.branch
scenario_or_breakage: Argv/env branch can disagree with the state file while git matches state; a resume write can persist the wrong BRANCH_NAME and break forked state-only open-pr checks or the next resume classification
suggested_fix: On non-fresh paths, hydrate working from persisted state keys used in validation (at least BRANCH_NAME; REPO/RUN_ID/MANIFEST_PATH/MERGE/DRAFT/FORKED_TARGET/REPO_UNAVAILABLE when present) before any _write_ship_state, or teach _write_ship_state to preserve keys not supplied
